name: MATE (Multi-Agent Tree Engine)
description: A production-ready multi-agent orchestration engine built on Google ADK. Configure agents, tools, and LLM providers from a web dashboard with no code changes needed. Every agent listed in MCP_EXPOSED_AGENTS is served as its own Streamable HTTP MCP server at /agents/<agent>/mcp; GET /mcp lists them with their URLs. This listing connects to the built-in mate_help agent. Clients authenticate with a Personal Access Token from the MATE dashboard, sent as the header Authorization: Bearer mate_pat_...; the token's user needs the admin or developer role. Supports 50+ LLM providers including local Ollama, persistent memory, RBAC, and multi-tenant project isolation. Requires an LLM provider key such as GOOGLE_API_KEY.
author: antiv

tools.name: call_mate_help_agent
tools.description: Call the mate_help agent with a message. Returns the agent's response.

prompts.description: Ask the mate_help agent a question about using MATE and its dashboard; it answers from the documentation.
